notes: בְּיוֹם בּוֹא גוֹג is rendered 'when Gog shall come', one English word for the preposition and its construct noun together, so rule 30 fuses them; the competing reading would give 'when' to the בְּ alone and leave יוֹם unrepresented, against rule 2. Rule 52's rider does not bite, since the ASV writes no second temporal word here.
The frame's 'that' stays with היה, since the apodosis תַּעֲלֶה חֲמָתִי writes no waw of its own (rule 45).
